text: The theory DLO of dense linear orders without endpoints is ℵ₀-categorical: all of its countable models are isomorphic to (ℚ, <). By Vaught's test this makes DLO a ___ theory, since it decides every sentence.
explanation: κ-categoricity (here ℵ₀-categoricity) together with having no finite models yields completeness by Vaught's test, so DLO is a complete theory: for every sentence φ, DLO ⊢ φ or DLO ⊢ ¬φ. The expected single term is 'complete'.
